reviewed_commit: working tree after docs/24 batch F1-F5 (uncommitted at capture time)
purpose: Recorded live measurements of the overhauled workspace surface. These are layout and labelling measurements of one browser build, not load, concurrency, fluent-language or scientific acceptance tests.

measurements.note: The question box and the Ask button are both inside the first viewport without scrolling.
Rail collapses to a sheet below 980px; the desk stays conversation-first.
Two-column shell: evidence ledger rail beside the conversation.
Measured with a real retrieved answer present: the thread scrolls internally and the composer stays pinned.

accessibility_and_policy.note: Every form control has a label, every button has an accessible name, a skip link and five live regions exist, and no inline style attribute is used, which keeps the page inside the served Content-Security-Policy. Contrast, focus order, screen-reader behaviour and keyboard-only journeys have NOT been independently audited.

journeys.question: Will it rain in Ahmedabad, Gujarat tomorrow morning?
journeys.observed: Headline value and unit, full-width validity ruler with IST ticks and a coverage bar, dark evidence receipt with entity, window, source, record paths and retrieval time, requested-task disclosure, sources, provenance trace, per-answer actions and the serving-lifetime notice.

journeys.question: And what about the afternoon?
journeys.observed: A second turn was added without losing the first, and the conversation identifier was kept.

journeys.question: Show the annual rainfall trend for Ahmedabad district, Gujarat from 1981 to 2010.
journeys.observed: The card is titled a retrieved series, leads with the computed 54.654 mm/decade and its stated method, draws the 30-point series, and gives a series receipt. No single year is presented as the answer.

journeys.question: What are the wave conditions near Kochi, Kerala tomorrow?
journeys.observed: Three plotted series with the answering model cell named in the values, and the source limits carried in the notes.

journeys.question: Tell me about rainfall in Bhopal.
journeys.observed: Every candidate is offered with its district, state, source and coordinates, plus a way to type a different place. The newest card is revealed from its top so the choices are reachable without hunting.

journeys.question: open, search and delete a stored conversation
journeys.outcome: verified in browser and in component checks
journeys.observed: 283 stored conversations were listed with bounded excerpts, searched by question text, and the delete control removed one through the local route.

not_measured: sustained load, cold-start latency and concurrent-question behaviour
screen-reader and keyboard-only journeys, and colour contrast
fluent Hindi or Gujarati output review
mobile platform compliance: this remains a desktop web surface
forecast skill, probability calibration or scientific validation
official warning applicability and any delivery or subscription behaviour
